Name: Pokemon Day Care - Digspots
Author: Parme69
Description:
[size=5][b]Pokemon Day Care - Digspots[/b][/size]

The wriggling worms of artifact spots and the seed spots become Poke Balls or Diglett.

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Artifact spots[/b] (worms): Poke Ball by default[/*]
[*][b]Seed spots[/b]: Diglett by default[/*]
[*]Each spot type has its own setting: 38 Balls (Poke, Great, Ultra, Master, Safari, Apricorn Balls, Strange, Feather, Origin, colour Balls...), Diglett, Wiglett or Alolan Diglett[/*]
[*][b]Random[/b]: a different Ball or Pokemon every day[/*]
[*]Animated like the original sprites, the loot is unchanged[/*]
[*]Settings in Generic Mod Config Menu, in English and French[/*]
[/list]New: "Random (Poke Balls)" and "Random (Pokemon)" options, so artifact spots and seed spots can each keep their own theme while still changing every day.

[b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
[*]Content Patcher[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu (optional, to change the settings in game)[/*]
[/list]
[b]Installation[/b]
Unzip into your Mods folder. Safe to add or remove at any time, it only changes images.
[b]Updating from an older version:[/b] the mod ID changed to Parme.PokemonDayCareDigspots. Delete the old folder before installing this one.

[b]Pokemon Day Care series[/b]
This mod is part of the Pokemon Day Care series but does not need the main mod.

Downloads.Description:
Delete the old folder before installing; your settings go back to default.
Use it with or without Pokemon Day Care expansion
